name: @red-cup-engineering/markdown-vault-graph-service
description: Derives a tiered graph — link, frontmatter-reference, and external-URL tiers — over a Markdown notes vault, resolving relative links, wikilinks, and transclusions to vault-relative file addresses content-digested by SHA-256, and reporting unresolved references and slug collisions as defects. Use when charting how a vault of Markdown notes cites, transcludes, or depends on itself, or when asking what a note links to and what nothing resolves.
